nodes.name: Read Mock Marketing Data
nodes.notes: Point this at your own copy of automation/mock-marketing-data-template.csv imported into Google Sheets. See SETUP_GUIDE.md.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: "claude-haiku-4-5-20251001", max_tokens: 400, messages: [ { role: "user", content: `Write a short (120-160 word) morning marketing brief for a Digital Marketing Director, in a direct, confident tone. Today's metrics: spend ₹${$json.spend}, revenue ₹${$json.revenue}, blended ROAS ${$json.roas}x (${$json.roas_delta_pct}% vs yesterday), ${$json.leads} leads, budget pacing at ${$json.budget_pacing_pct}% of plan. Anomalies: ${$json.anomalies.length ? $json.anomalies.join('; ') : 'none detected'}. End with exactly 3 numbered recommended actions.` } ] }) }}

nodes.name: Generate AI Narrative (Claude)
nodes.notes: Requires an HTTP Header Auth credential named 'Anthropic API' with header x-api-key = your Anthropic API key. See SETUP_GUIDE.md.

parameters.subject: =MarkOS Morning Brief (fallback) — {{ $('Compute Metrics').item.json.date }}
parameters.message: =The AI narrative step failed this morning. Raw metrics for {{ $('Compute Metrics').item.json.date }}: spend ₹{{ $('Compute Metrics').item.json.spend }}, revenue ₹{{ $('Compute Metrics').item.json.revenue }}, ROAS {{ $('Compute Metrics').item.json.roas }}x, leads {{ $('Compute Metrics').item.json.leads }}, budget pacing {{ $('Compute Metrics').item.json.budget_pacing_pct }}%. Check the Anthropic API credential and node run history.

meta.description: MarkOS AI Module 11 (Reporting & Dashboard Engine) — daily automated morning brief. Pulls sample marketing data, computes metrics, generates an AI narrative, and emails it. Built as a real, importable n8n workflow to accompany the MarkOS AI portfolio project.
